Peterson family · Person

Erik Hilmer Pettersson

1882–1962

Open in the family tree

Names in the records
Erik Hilmer Peterson, Hilmer Peterson, Erick Hilmer Petersen, Erick Hilmer Peterson

Pettersson and Peterson are spelling variants used for Hilmer. A 1959 letter describes him arriving in America as a boy. Other family records point to a later arrival. The date and ship remain unresolved.

Family connections

Parents Ericka Munter, Johannes Gustaf Pettersson

Spouses and partners Mary Alvey

Children with Mary Alvey: Alvey Lynn Peterson, Hilmer Stanley Peterson, Joseph Dean Peterson, Maurine Peterson, Maxine Peterson, Merle Peterson, Private family member, Robert Glen Peterson, William Jay Peterson
